description: List your workspace's marketplace payout runs, newest first: each run's id, status (a dry run, awaiting approval, rejected, stale, approved, processing, partial, paid or failed), period, total, Stripe mode, the transfers it plans and the entries it skips, who requested it and who decided it. execution says whether payout runs are switched on for your workspace and whether Stripe is ready. They are not switched on for every workspace yet: while they are off for yours, execution.enabled is false and no runs are listed. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: How many runs at most, newest first. Defaults to 20.

name: list_payout_runs
